name: agent-case-share-skills
description: Search, retrieve saved items and public community discussions, capture selected environments and Sessions, export case ZIP packages, and publish Agent Case Share content through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Search your library, capture run materials, and publish content.
interface.longDescription: Search and automatically retrieve public content, saved and personal libraries, and public community discussions through MCP. Capture and convert selected Agent environments, Sessions, or both for local export or upload to your cases. Publish or edit cases, community discussions and replies, immutable Agent environment snapshots, Session transcripts, external case videos, case attachments, articles, Markdown images, reusable assets, and user-editable metadata from AI coding agents.
